Michael Reid

About the author

Michael E. Reid also known as "Just Mike The Poet" is an Author, Poet, and Speaker from Philadelphia, Pa. Michael uses Poetry/Spoken Word as a platform to inspire individuals through the daily trials and tribulations of life. Michael also uses his gift of having a way with words as a means for counseling those who feel life has left them alone. In his Books "Just Words" & "Just Words 2" Michael touches on everything from, Love, Relationships, Family, Friends, Death, Life, with the goal of igniting change by its readers.
